## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `32a1b5f570639071b83bd313ae88ac04e8163c3a`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/triage.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md + scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs (MAILBOX_KEYS, MAILBOX_FIELD_READERS, readMailboxLine, mailboxKeyLines, the self-test rows), scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (the three CEILINGS rows, the raise rule in the header, MAX_LINE_BYTES and its at-most comparison, MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES), scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs (H72, the one other reader of the key table through `mailboxEvents`), scripts/pm/check-handover.mjs (the sign-off hand-back it enforces), scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs (the pattern it scans), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md (交接收尾清单 step 2 and 5), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md (RECLAIM_AFTER_HOURS, the release shape), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md (阻塞项无主, 接管 four items), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md (无主阻塞项), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md (越界四通道, `pm:dispatched`, the `Resume-from:` order line)

Inputs: card #29754 body and all six comments (amendments 6595244387 and 6595840476, the block/unblock pair 6595266411 and 6595519090, claim 6599695105, os-dev-report 6600243251); decision card #29775 and its ruling record 6595514258 (「同意29775 A」); PR #29887 body, its five-file list and the net diff `origin/main...pr/29887` (merge base 592845b0, head 32a1b5f5); the check-runs on that head. Not the dispatch order and not the dispatching seat's conclusions.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept-set / public surface: none.** The diff touches `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/**` (three files) and `scripts/pm/**` (two files). No `packages/**`, no published schema, no workflow, no hook, no label definition, no state. `Check Changeset` success with `skip-changeset`.
- **Ceiling raises, each against the ratchet's raise rule** (header: a raise is authorised only by the ruling of record that orders text into the file, quoted by id with the measured delta, moved by at most that delta; nothing unruled). Measured on the tree, not the PR body: line counts `origin/main` → `pr/29887` are triage.md 17 → 20, project-forms.md 56 → 58, seat-lifecycle.md 96 → 98; the three `origin/main` CEILINGS rows were 17 / 56 / 96; the raised rows are 20 / 58 / 98. Delta equals landed count in every row (headroom 0, the map's convention).
  - `lanes/triage.md` 17 → 20 (+3): the three new lines are the sweep and idle reading (amendment 2 item 1, 6595840476, which names this file), the knock / next-round read / unanswered list / two-silent-rounds escalation (Wanted item 3 as amended by 6595244387, ruled A in 6595514258), and the hand-over to the online sibling with the one knock and 「分诊永不释放」 (amendment 2 item 2, triage's part). Row comment quotes 6595514258 「同意29775 A」, 6595244387 and 6595840476 「同意：下班席位的卡交给兄弟席」. Every new line is 116–119 bytes, so none folds into a neighbour. Nothing unruled added.
  - `project-forms.md` 56 → 58 (+2): the key row (Wanted item 1, 「新增一对键」 in #29775, ruled A) and the record/rate line (amendment 1). The 不敲 line is a rewrite in place, paid in place. Row comment quotes 6595514258, 6595244387, 6595840476. Nothing unruled added.
  - `seat-lifecycle.md` 96 → 98 (+2): when the hand-over applies and who claims plus the three exceptions (amendment 2 item 2, which names this file). The sign-off line is rewritten in place. Row comment quotes 6595840476 and 6595514258. The comment's tail 「which names this file」 attaches to record 6595514258, which does not name seat-lifecycle.md; amendment 6595840476 does (should-fix, comment wording only).
  - Amendment 2 is accepted as a ruling of record on the same footing the map already uses: it carries the maintainer's verbatim word (「同意：下班席位的卡交给兄弟席」), the same shape as the amendment comment 6592303181 cited by the neighbouring rows.
  - None of the three files is a `CROSS_FILE_MOVES` participant, so no `was` record is owed; the `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` pins (0 for all three) are untouched and still hold since no table row was added. Map total +7 is a raise sum, not a cross-file move, so condition (b) does not apply.
- **Byte cap.** Every added or rewritten line measured: 119, 116, 116 (triage.md); 112, 118, 119 (project-forms.md); 120, 118, 119 (seat-lifecycle.md). The ratchet's check passes a line whose byte count is at most `MAX_LINE_BYTES` (the comparison is less-than-or-equal, `MAX_LINE_BYTES = 120`), so the 120-byte sign-off line is within budget, not over it.
- **id-lint.** The scanned corpus (every `.md` under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/`) gains no `#` followed by three or more digits: the new lines carry `#n`-free text, `security#1` and `≥3h` only. The record and comment ids live in the ratchet's row comments and the recogniser's doc comment, both script headers outside the lint's corpus. `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates` and `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests` are success on the head.
- **Check-runs on 32a1b5f5 (the gate verdicts): 46 total, all completed — 26 success, 20 skipped, 0 failure, 0 cancelled.** Among the successes: `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · ESLint`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Type Check · workspace / source gates / consumer gates / debt ledger`, `Test Core (1/8)`, `Test Core (2/8)`, `Test UI`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`. The skipped rows are path-filtered UI, docs and opt-in jobs with no input on this diff.
- **Mailbox key list, every reader.** `MAILBOX_KEYS` is read by `record-recognisers.mjs` itself and, lazily through `mailboxEvents`, by `check-half-states.mjs` H72, which spells no key or count of its own (its battery pins exactly that). `mailboxKeyLines()` prints the count from `MAILBOX_KEYS.length`, so 「17 keys」 is derived, not written. No skill text states a key count (project-forms.md 〈信箱 PR〉 names keys and points at `--mailbox-keys`); the only count pin is the roster self-test row, moved 15 → 17 on both `MAILBOX_KEYS` and `MAILBOX_FIELD_READERS`. `post-stamped.mjs` validates no mailbox line; no workflow or other script composes a `Request:`/`Notify:` line.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is correct: nothing published moves. The PR body carries `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`; the diff is governed rules text plus two unpublished `scripts/pm/` files, so no narrowing arm and no declaration is owed beyond that. `Check Changeset`: success.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Deviation 1 (relay `pr_create` `--session` typed `…JTyLyKbj` for `…JTyLuKbj`).** Answered on the tree and the PR: the commit trailer of 74471690 (`Claude-Session: …/session_01WGufzf7EDaUFBmJTyLuKbj`), the PR body's closing link and the os-dev-report all carry the correct id; the PR's attribution comment names the login only. `PR-body guards (claim · duplicate · Part-of · single-writer path)` is success, so the envelope's slip reached no record of record. Nothing to correct on this head.
- **Deviation 2 (`origin/main` moved 592845b0 → 74fd4bf6 while the PR opened).** Measured: `git diff --stat 592845b0 origin/main` over `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`, `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, `record-recognisers.mjs`, `check-half-states.mjs` and `check-skill-id-lint.mjs` is empty, so the three-dot diff and the ceiling baselines (17 / 56 / 96 on today's `origin/main`) are unchanged by the drift. Answered.
- **`open_questions`: none declared.** No dev flag asks for a ruling; none is escalated here.
- **Governance.** `.claude/**` is a Tier S path; this record is the Tier S review of record. The PR is a draft on the base repository (not a fork). `Governed Surface Queue Guard`: success.

### ④ Design judgment

Judged on the tree at 32a1b5f5 against the card as amended and ruling A; the PR body's account was not relied on.

- **Both keys round-trip.** `request:progress`: `readMailboxLine` finds the entry by kind+first word, applies the byte cap and the one-line rule, then `MAILBOX_FIELD_READERS['request:progress']` requires exactly three fields, a bare `#n` through `NUMBER_REF` and `idle since TIME` through `IDLE_SINCE_REF` (a `Z` time in `CLAIM_TIME`'s spelling, seconds optional, optional backticks). The fixture `Request: progress · #29420 · idle since 2026-11-03T00:06Z` under `To: domain:skills#1` reads with `item`, `since`, `numbers=[29420]`, `to='domain:skills#1'`; the placeholder `TIME`, a duration, a bare date, a local-offset time, `PR #n`, a missing and a fourth field fall to `unreadable` with `does not spell`. `notify:progress`: three fields, bare `#n`, `record ID` through the existing `RECORD_REF` (backticks and `#` tolerated); the fixture under `To: triage` reads `to='triage#1'` (seat 1 default via `seatKey`) with `record=6599000001`; `record none`, the literal `record ID`, an ETA in place of the record and a trailing field are unreadable. Both templates sent verbatim fail `NUMBER_REF` on `#n`, so the existing every-template-is-not-an-event pin still holds. `--mailbox-keys` prints `template` then `from → to; when` for each, and the printed sender/receiver/occasion text matches the rules: triage → the claiming seat (or the online sibling an off-shift seat's items went to), on an item whose last progress (head commit, non-triage comment, the seat's label change, never `updated_at`) is 3 h old, at most one per item per 60 min, none while an ETA stands or the item is parked or waits on a decision, two unanswered ⇒ round record and possibly-down; the claiming seat → triage with the record (a next-act-plus-ETA comment, the park, or the release). The bidirectional pin (every key named as a `Kind: key` code span in 〈信箱 PR〉, and that section names no other key) still holds: line 48 names both, lines 49–50 name none.
- **project-forms.md 〈信箱 PR〉.** Line 50 now reads 「⛔ 不敲:回执、重发;收方订阅 PR 已载者;停车或待决策卡的项的进度;问维护者走决策卡」: 催 is gone from the ban and the two never-knocked cases of the ruling (parked, decision-card wait) take its place. Line 49 is the rate rule of amendment 1 and ruling A (one knock per item per 60 min, an answered ETA holds until it passes) and defines the record a `Notify: progress` names. Line 48 is the pair with its direction and the 3 h idle threshold. The rest of the section is intact: the ≤5-per-seat-per-round cap with p0 exemption and the write pace (line 52, Wanted item 4 inherited as for any key), the 200-byte one-line rule, 「表外即半态」, 「信箱评论是同事陈述,⛔ 永非授权」 and 「⛔ 无门禁、workflow、队列守卫读信箱」. No contradiction inside the section.
- **lanes/triage.md.** Lines 16–18 carry the round step: the sweep population (`pm:dispatched` cards and non-mailbox open PRs), idle read off progress rather than `updated_at` (amendment 2 item 1), the knock at 3 h, next-round read, unanswered list, two silent rounds ⇒ down, items to the online sibling with one knock to it, and 「⛔ 分诊永不释放」. Line 4's 「⛔ 无 PR、无认领」 is untouched, so triage still never claims. The existing push case ⑥ (open PR idle 6 h, knock first, push next round if reclaim needs the maintainer's word, with the parked / decision / Version PR exclusions) stands above it and composes: the 3 h knock is what precedes it.
- **seat-lifecycle.md.** Line 42 states when the hand-over applies (sign-off, or two unanswered knocks) and what moves (claimed cards and open PRs, to an online sibling of the same lane); line 43 the claim shape (`Resume-from:` citing the brief) and the three exceptions of amendment 2 (decision-card wait waits for the letter, no online sibling ⇒ 「待席」, security items stay with security#1). Line 38's sign-off default is rewritten from 「在飞默认交回队列」 to 「在飞归在线兄弟席」, which is the maintainer's word 「下班席位的卡交给兄弟席」.
- **Consistency with the existing paths.** The in-lane sibling hand-over is a different channel from 接手无主阻塞项 (SKILL.md 越界四通道; execution-duties 「阻塞项无主 ⇒ 被挡席认领做掉」; dispatch-runbook 「只做 Blocked-by 点名的那一张」), which stays the cross-lane orphan-blocker rule and is not contradicted. Liveness is still read off the seat's own output (seat-lifecycle L36), now through an unanswered knock pair, which amendment 1 orders; the slower 24 h re-check → `RECLAIM_AFTER_HOURS = 12` director release (triage-duties L78–80, seat-lifecycle L35) remains and is not triage's act either. No new gate, label or state: `pm:dispatched`, `Blocked-by:`, `Resume-from:`, `Notify: seat-offline` and the round record are all existing; 「待席」 is a round-record note, not a label.
- **Attempts to break it.**
  - **should-fix — L38 against the hand-back the gate enforces.** seat-post-protocol.md 交接收尾清单 step 2 still says 「同笔 `Release:`+`Resume-from:`+清 assignee 交回 `pm:queue`」 and step 5 gates the vacant body on `check-handover.mjs` exit 0, whose (a) CLAIM UNRELEASED refuses any open `pm:dispatched` card the departing session still holds without a `Release:`. Read as the destination (the sibling takes it from the queue after the `Release:`, told by the `in-flight:` list on `Notify: seat-offline`), L38 and step 2 compose; read literally, L38 tells the departing seat to skip the `Release:` and step 5 then reds. Not a must-fix: the gate still refuses the half-state before it can land, and the text is the maintainer's word; but L38 (or step 2) should name the transit — e.g. 「在飞 `Release:` 归在线兄弟席」 — so the two files agree on one act.
  - **should-fix — the two-knocks case has no brief to cite.** L43 「兄弟席 `Resume-from:` 引简报认领」 mirrors amendment 2 verbatim, but a seat that merely stopped answering wrote no 收班简报; the sibling's claim there goes through the execution-duties 接管 four-item shape (cross-account `Release:` with 出处三件, assignee swap, new `Claim:`, hand-over record) and the provenance it can cite is triage's round record naming the two unanswered knocks. A later edit should say so; the ruling itself left it unsaid.
  - **should-fix (minor) — sweep population.** triage.md L16 sweeps every non-mailbox open PR; the Version Packages PR (seat-lifecycle L79 「默认永不催」) and unowned PRs have no claiming seat to knock, which L17 implies but does not state; push ⑥ on L13–14 excludes them explicitly. Harmless in practice (no 认领席, no knock), worth one clause when the file is next touched.
  - Rate vs round: hourly rounds plus L49's 60-min rule give at most one knock per item per round; two rounds of silence is about 2 h, as amendment 1 measures it. A seat that answers with an ETA is held until it passes (L49); a seat that parks (§C `Blocked-by:` / `Resume-from:`) or waits on a decision card is never knocked (L50). Consistent in both directions.
  - `security#1` on L43 lost its backticks to fit 120 bytes; no gate reads seat names out of code spans in this file, and the id-lint pattern needs three digits. Not a finding.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-6q7l00`
Reviewed-by: `session_01WGufzhd2Ad9ANGTyAMW7pH`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d9e8647f4f59db2fee1595c68dd43178f553c792`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/triage.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md + scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs (MAILBOX_KEYS, MAILBOX_FIELD_READERS, readMailboxLine, mailboxKeyLines, the self-test rows), scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (the three CEILINGS rows, the raise rule in the header, MAX_LINE_BYTES and its at-most comparison, MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES), scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs (H72, the one other reader of the key table through `mailboxEvents`), scripts/pm/check-handover.mjs (the sign-off hand-back it enforces, (a) CLAIM UNRELEASED), scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs (the pattern it scans), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md (交接收尾清单 step 2 and 5), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md (RECLAIM_AFTER_HOURS, the release shape), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md (阻塞项无主, 接管 four items), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md (无主阻塞项), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md (越界四通道, `pm:dispatched`, the `Resume-from:` order line)

Round 1 on the head d9e8647f, which follows the round-0 record on 32a1b5f5 (PASS with three should-fixes). Inputs: card #29754 body and its six comments (amendments 6595244387 and 6595840476, the block/unblock pair, the claim, the os-dev-report), decision card #29775 and ruling record 6595514258 (「同意29775 A」), PR #29887's refreshed body, its file list, the net diff `origin/main...pr/29887` and the delta `git diff 32a1b5f5 pr/29887`, and the check-runs on d9e8647f. Not the dispatch order, not the dispatching seat's conclusions.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The delta.** One commit (d9e8647f) over the reviewed head: seat-lifecycle.md lines 38, 42 and 43 rewritten in place, and the seat-lifecycle.md CEILINGS row comment. No other file moved; triage.md, project-forms.md, record-recognisers.mjs and the two other CEILINGS rows are byte-identical to the round-0 head, so every round-0 derived judgment on them stands (keys round-trip, roster pin 15 → 17, templates unreadable, H72 one reader, no key count written anywhere, id-lint clean).
- **Accept-set / public surface: none.** Net diff is still `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/**` (three files) plus `scripts/pm/**` (two files). `skip-changeset` holds.
- **Ceiling raises, re-measured on the tree.** Line counts `origin/main` → `pr/29887`: triage.md 17 → 20, project-forms.md 56 → 58, seat-lifecycle.md 96 → 98; `origin/main` CEILINGS rows 17 / 56 / 96; raised rows 20 / 58 / 98. The delta commit changed no count: the three seat-lifecycle lines were rewritten in place, so the +2 raise still equals the two lines amendment 6595840476 orders into that file, and the row comment now attaches 「which names this file」 to amendment 6595840476 (correct) under record 6595514258. The other two rows' comments and the raise rule reading are as in round 0: each quoted by id, each moved by exactly the measured delta, nothing unruled added, no `CROSS_FILE_MOVES` participant, `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` pins (0) untouched.
- **Byte cap.** The three rewritten lines measure 117, 118 and 120 bytes; the six unchanged new lines 119, 116, 116, 112, 118, 119. The ratchet admits a line whose byte count is at most `MAX_LINE_BYTES = 120` (less-than-or-equal), so the 120-byte line 43 is within budget.
- **id-lint.** The rewritten lines add no `#` followed by three or more digits (「接管四件」, 「轮次记录」, 「安全席」 carry none); the ids remain in script headers outside the lint's corpus.
- **Content pins.** No script reads seat-lifecycle.md's text (`check-half-states.mjs`, `fleet-roster.mjs` and `mailbox-open.mjs` cite it in comments only); the ratchet reads its count and widths. The clause 「派发口径失效」 dropped from line 38 to make room appears nowhere else in the corpus; its substance (a successor inherits no dispatch calibre from the predecessor) survives in the kept 「简报非继承裁决」, so no rule is lost, only its restatement.
- **Check-runs on d9e8647f (the gate verdicts): 45 total, all completed — 26 success, 19 skipped, 0 failure, 0 cancelled.** Among the successes: `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus`, `Lint · ESLint`, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Type Check · workspace / source gates / consumer gates / debt ledger`, `Test Core`, `Test Core (1/8)`, `Test Core (2/8)`, `Test UI`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Check PR Size`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`. The skipped rows are path-filtered UI, docs and opt-in jobs with no input on this diff; the ratchet, id-lint, recogniser self-test and check-handover self-test ride in the PM dispatch-gates and repo & tooling gates rows.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is correct: nothing published moves. The refreshed PR body still carries `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`; the diff is governed rules text plus two unpublished `scripts/pm/` files, so no narrowing arm and no further declaration is owed. On this head both `Check Changeset` rows concluded `skipped` (the `skip-changeset` label, a path-filtered run); the identical changeset state was `success` on 32a1b5f5, and the delta commit touches no package, so the level is unchanged.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Round-0 deviations 1 and 2** (the relay `--session` typo; `origin/main` drift 592845b0 → 74fd4bf6) were answered in round 0 on the tree and stay answered: the delta commit adds no new deviation and the drift touched none of the five files.
- **Round-1 item declared not taken (triage.md line 16, the sweep population).** The dev reports the narrowing to owned, non-Version PRs does not fit 120 bytes without dropping the idle reading. Judged acceptable: line 16 names the population only; line 17 knocks 「认领席」, so an item with no claiming seat (the Version Packages PR, an unowned PR) has no addressee and no knock fires; push ⑥ on lines 12–14 keeps its own exclusion list (待裁, `Blocked-by:`, `status:parked`, 栈阻者, 信箱, Version PR) for what triage pushes; and seat-lifecycle.md line 79 (「Version Packages PR 默认永不催」) still binds. The idle reading is the ruled text (amendment 2 item 1); the exclusion was a reviewer's minor, not an ordered line. Closed as accepted, no edit owed.
- **`open_questions`: none.** Nothing escalated.
- **Governance.** `.claude/**` is a Tier S path; this record is the Tier S review of record for d9e8647f. The PR is a draft on the base repository.

### ④ Design judgment

Judged on the tree at d9e8647f against the card as amended and ruling A; the PR body's account was not relied on. The round-0 judgments on project-forms.md 〈信箱 PR〉, lanes/triage.md and the two keys stand unchanged (those files are byte-identical). The delta is judged below.

- **Should-fix 1 — closed.** Line 38 now reads 「收班 = 状态 flush + 在飞 `Release:`+`Resume-from:` 回队待兄弟席、不等落地;简报非继承裁决」. The departing seat's act is the existing hand-back: `Release:` with `Resume-from:` back to `pm:queue`, where the card waits for the sibling. That is exactly the shape seat-post-protocol.md 收尾清单 step 2 spells (「同笔 `Release:`+`Resume-from:`+清 assignee 交回 `pm:queue`」) and the one `check-handover.mjs` (a) CLAIM UNRELEASED reads (a `Release:` carrying the departing session after its newest `Claim:`), so a seat following line 38 passes step 5 and cannot red at check-handover. The sibling is named as the next claimant, which is the maintainer's word 「下班席位的卡交给兄弟席」 kept whole: the destination is the sibling, the transit is the queue. Line 44's stay-behind exception (只写点名的已 ACCEPT 待队列或待人批 PR) is untouched and still matches check-handover's narrowed stay-behind.
- **Should-fix 2 — closed.** Line 42 「下班席(`seat-offline`,或两敲 `Request: progress` 无答走接管四件)的在飞归同车道在线兄弟席」 routes the no-brief case through execution-duties.md's 接管 shape (「认领人不可达 ⇒ 接管:一条评论四件齐」: ① a cross-account `Release:` naming the withdrawn claim's id and session with 出处三件, ② the assignee swapped in the same stroke, ③ a new `Claim:` continuing the branch and sha, ④ the hand-over record), and line 43 「兄弟席 `Resume-from:` 引简报或轮次记录认领」 names what the sibling cites: the brief when the seat signed off, triage's round record (which lists the two unanswered knocks, triage.md line 17) when it did not. That is coherent end to end: the two unanswered knocks are the 「不可达」 trigger the ruling adds, the round record is the 出处 the takeover's ① requires, and C9's one red (a cross-account `Claim:` with no `Release:` at all) is avoided because the takeover writes the `Release:` itself. Triage still neither claims nor releases (triage.md lines 4 and 18); the release in the takeover is the sibling's act, as execution-duties already has it.
- **Line 43's other rewrites.** 「无兄弟席「待席」」 keeps the no-online-sibling exception (the round record is where 「待席」 is written, triage.md line 17's 轮次记录); 「安全归安全席」 keeps security items with the security seat (`security#1`, lanes/security.md) in four characters instead of the login-shaped spelling; 「待裁先等字」 unchanged.
